critical_code_review_comments: Auth gate `require_hr_or_admin` correctly resolves via `_actor` from `_require_any_portal_token`. PM/Shop/Safety/Dispatch correctly get 403. Anonymous gets 401. Verified by explicit X-Admin-Token='' overrides that bypass conftest auto-auth.

Playbook fan-out is fire-and-forget via try/except per row — a notification/task service hiccup on one row won't abort the others, good defensive pattern. tasks_created reflects only successful inserts.
Replay guard is correct: `triggers_playbook = new ∈ {Terminated,Resigned,Retired} AND prev NOT ∈ same set` — Terminated→Resigned is suppressed, Inactive→Terminated correctly fires.
is_active is kept in sync with the {Active, Pending Hire, Seasonal, Leave of Absence} cohort, so the legacy /api/employees dropdown drops terminated folks automatically. Confirmed empirically.
Default LIST query: `{$or: [lifecycle_status ∈ active-set, lifecycle_status missing AND is_active != false]}` correctly surfaces both new lifecycle rows and the 235+ legacy rows.
_strip_id() handles ObjectId removal everywhere; no _id leak in responses (spot-checked POST/GET/PATCH/status/summary).
Pydantic @field_validator on lifecycle_status enforces the 9-value whitelist on both create and status-change paths.
offboarding-summary correctly filters open_tasks by status ∈ [Open, In Progress, Pending Review, Overdue] and excludes Archived/Not-Applicable docs.
Minor: `_OFFBOARDING_PLAYBOOK` is defined module-scope — fine. If MASCI wants to customize per company in future, this is easy to lift to db.settings.

Frontend HrEmployees.jsx data-testid coverage is comprehensive (page / show-inactive / add-trigger / add-dialog / add-submit / drawer / 3 tabs / status-new / status-reason / status-save) — testability is excellent. Only miss: Radix DialogTitle a11y.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase C is fully functional. Cross-system integration with Phase A (task_service) verified — 8-task playbook fans out with correct source_module='hr.offboarding', linked_employee_id, and the documented role mix (hr×2 + shop×2 + admin×2 + safety×1 + pm×1). Phase B (document_expirations) integration verified via offboarding-summary aggregation. IMPORTANT for future tests: /app/backend/tests/conftest.py monkey-patches requests to auto-attach X-Admin-Token to every call hitting the backend URL — to test non-admin auth, explicitly pass `headers={'X-Admin-Token': ''}` (or override) to disable auto-auth. The replay-guard logic only fires the playbook on the FIRST transition into the offboarding set — re-terminating or Terminated→Resigned is suppressed (tasks_created=0). For Phase D/E, you can reuse the same status_history + replay-guard pattern.
rca of the issue: No functional bugs found in Phase C. Initial 2 pytest failures were a test-harness artifact, not a product bug: the shared /app/backend/tests/conftest.py auto-attaches X-Admin-Token to every `requests.*` call (so my 'unauthenticated' and 'Safety token only' tests were silently authed as admin and got 200 instead of 401/403). Fixed the tests by setting `headers={'X-Admin-Token': '', 'X-Safety-Token': ...}` to override the conftest default. After the fix, all 15 backend tests pass and curl directly confirms 401 (anon) and 403 (Safety) behavior on the production endpoint. The actual product auth is correctly gated.
